shorts.title: What you will learn: this and const methods
shorts.hook: Every object knows its own address.
shorts.script: Every object knows its own address. Today we meet the hidden pointer that every member function receives. It points to the object that made the call. Inside a member function, the name this is a pointer to the current object. You rarely need to write it, but it explains how member functions work. A function that returns star this lets you chain calls. Keep coding, says Xecxec!

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A non-const call on a const object
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in this and const methods?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in this and const methods? Bug of the Day. The object is const, but we call increment. The compiler says passing const Counter as this argument discards qualifiers. That sounds hard, but it means this. A const object cannot call a function that may change it. A const object may not change, so it may not call a function that can change it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
